coordinate_frame.bearing_definition: degrees clockwise from +X toward +Y viewed from above

operator_facing_frame.viewpoint: operator standing in front of and facing the ZED
operator_facing_frame.bearing_definition: degrees clockwise from +X toward +Y viewed from above

phase_boundary.allowed_claim: functional engineering characterization of the exact tested rig, source, placements, room, and analysis path

stopping_rule.diminishing_information_gain: an additional compatible trial would duplicate a stable covered result

matrix.occlusion: operator-identified rigid ordinary object fully blocks direct line between Mac speakers and rig without touching either
near rear boundary; source distance and room boundary confounded by access

operator_protocol.physical_instruction_order: operator viewpoint first in F_operator_facing_zed, then canonical F_project in parentheses
operator_protocol.standardized_voice_phrase: Audio pilot check, one two three, direction test.
operator_protocol.privacy: no names, identifiers, screens, private labels, third-party media, people, or hands in retained ZED frames
operator_protocol.source_orientation: same general heading as ZED; practical visual placement
operator_protocol.room_occupancy: zero other people for controlled and repeatability trials

bearing_doa_error.method: SRP-PHAT primary and existing GCC-PHAT least-squares comparison on frozen raw-channel windows
bearing_doa_error.reference: practical marked source bearing in F_project
bearing_doa_error.uncertainty: 5 deg placement reference plus 2 deg grid; acoustic-axis uncertainty unmeasured
bearing_doa_error.aggregation: window and trial count, median, MAD, nearest-rank p95, worst
bearing_doa_error.exclusions: quality-invalid or abstained windows excluded from numeric error but counted
bearing_doa_error.missing: required reference trial fails metric coverage
bearing_doa_error.applicability: reference, voice, overlap, rear, and impact active windows
bearing_doa_error.limitations: nominal mic geometry and approximate array/project alignment

candidate_bearing.method: candidate set emitted by existing estimators; coverage within frozen 20 deg tolerance
candidate_bearing.aggregation: candidate count, coverage fraction, median and worst nearest-candidate error
candidate_bearing.limitations: not a calibrated probability or exhaustive multipath solution

sector_accuracy.method: existing eight-sector mapping of primary bearing
sector_accuracy.uncertainty: boundary cases within 5 deg labeled uncertain
sector_accuracy.exclusions: boundary-uncertain reported separately; abstentions incorrect for active source
sector_accuracy.missing: required reference trial fails metric coverage

tdoa.method: existing GCC-PHAT pair matrix over four raw channels
tdoa.reference: nominal plane-wave delay from nominal geometry, 343 m/s, and practical bearing
tdoa.uncertainty: 62.5 us sample period reduced only computationally by interpolation; nominal geometry and environmental speed not measured
tdoa.aggregation: per pair count, median, MAD, p95, worst and repeatability range
tdoa.missing: required active reference trial fails metric coverage
tdoa.limitations: contains propagation, room, geometry, firmware, and estimator effects

channel_presence_order_health.method: WAV header and device identity plus documented firmware channel map; per-channel finite/silence/clipping checks
channel_presence_order_health.uncertainty: channel labels Verified by firmware contract; physical acoustic centers not independently traced
channel_presence_order_health.aggregation: all attempts and channels; failure counts and worst clip run
channel_presence_order_health.limitations: order is contract verification, not injected per-microphone traceability

channel_imbalance.method: raw-channel RMS relative to raw-channel median
channel_imbalance.uncertainty: PCM quantization and window selection; no absolute calibration
channel_imbalance.aggregation: count, median, MAD, p95, worst per channel
channel_imbalance.missing: reported missing for intended silence and fails active reference coverage

relative_rms_level.method: PCM RMS full-scale and relative dB against baseline trial medians
relative_rms_level.reference: digital full scale and frozen baseline
relative_rms_level.uncertainty: PCM quantization, placement 0.02 m, uncontrolled room microvariation
relative_rms_level.applicability: all trials, with silence treated as noise floor

combined_spectrum.method: Hann-window FFT energy in frozen bands relative to total frozen-band energy
combined_spectrum.reference: same-window total energy and baseline band medians
combined_spectrum.uncertainty: FFT bin width and windowing; source/room/sensor inseparable
combined_spectrum.aggregation: count, median, MAD, p95, worst by band
combined_spectrum.limitations: not isolated speaker or microphone response

relative_channel_delay.method: GCC-PHAT delay relative to raw microphone 0
relative_channel_delay.aggregation: count, median, MAD, p95, worst per channel
relative_channel_delay.limitations: includes acoustic path and cannot isolate hardware delay

major_polarity_anomaly.method: sign of aligned peak cross-correlation for raw pairs; persistent negative median across active baseline windows is major
major_polarity_anomaly.reference: raw microphone 0 and majority pair sign
major_polarity_anomaly.uncertainty: multipath can alter sign; only major persistent anomalies claimed
major_polarity_anomaly.aggregation: pair/window counts and persistent anomaly count

capture_to_frame_latency.method: 250 ms replay window duration plus measured analysis runtime after window availability
capture_to_frame_latency.uncertainty: monotonic timer resolution and host scheduling
capture_to_frame_latency.limitations: offline functional latency, not live capture/network latency

frame_to_adapter_latency.method: canonical analysis-frame JSON encode/decode round trip measured with monotonic clock
frame_to_adapter_latency.limitations: local serialization adapter only, not SquadBot transport

noise.method: raw-channel RMS, spectrum, and transient rate during intended-silence windows
noise.exclusions: declared unexpected source windows remain failures and are not deleted
noise.missing: silence trial failure leaves metric uncovered

echo_relative_decay.method: energy-envelope time to -10 dB and -20 dB after frozen chirp or impact peak when observable
echo_relative_decay.uncertainty: one analysis hop plus event localization
echo_relative_decay.aggregation: event count, median, range, worst; censored count
echo_relative_decay.exclusions: events without 20 dB dynamic range are censored and counted
echo_relative_decay.missing: reported unmeasured when no observable decay
echo_relative_decay.limitations: relative combined decay, not certified RT60

occlusion.method: paired robustness-minus-baseline changes in level, spectrum, bearing error, confidence, and abstention
occlusion.uncertainty: unreplicated occluder placement and baseline spread
occlusion.aggregation: paired deltas with baseline spread and worst
occlusion.missing: occlusion trial failure leaves metric uncovered

overlap.method: overlap-minus-baseline changes in detections, bearing error, confidence, ambiguity, and abstention
overlap.aggregation: counts, medians, p95, worst and deltas

silence.method: frozen signal detector over central intended-silence windows
silence.aggregation: window count, detection and abstention rates, worst RMS

confidence.aggregation: count, median, MAD, p95, worst by trial/category

ambiguity.method: candidate count plus confidence below 0.05 low-confidence ambiguity flag

abstention.method: abstain unless median raw RMS exceeds 0.002 FS and SRP confidence is at least 0.015
abstention.aggregation: counts/rates by trial/category and silence acceptance
abstention.limitations: pilot policy, not fitted production threshold

acquisition_analysis_failures.method: inventory lifecycle, validator issues, exceptions, missing data, and nonfinite results
acquisition_analysis_failures.reference: all planned trials and all attempts
acquisition_analysis_failures.aggregation: counts by category/trial/outcome/reason and worst unresolved state
acquisition_analysis_failures.limitations: does not infer causes without evidence

coarse_audio_video_association.method: visible impact sample versus manually reviewed ZED frame using S4.2 elapsed-time offset convention
coarse_audio_video_association.uncertainty: one audio sample, audio localization, half frame interval, and one-frame visual localization RSS
coarse_audio_video_association.exclusions: privacy-invalid media retained only per authorized privacy policy and cannot pass
coarse_audio_video_association.missing: impact-AV trial failure leaves metric uncovered
coarse_audio_video_association.limitations: coarse association, not synchronization or absolute capture latency
